title: Leaf-level model and augmentation configurations for Leaf-EFEH electrical response prediction
description:
Workbook of leaf-level model and data-augmentation configurations used to predict open-circuit voltage and short-circuit current of leaf-based electric field energy harvesters.

Sheets: Table7_selection (best and worst augmented configuration by species, response, and model); Brassica_fixed (fixed settings for Brassica rapa pekinensis); Spinacia_ranges (ranges and most frequent categorical choices for Spinacia oleracea); Spinacia_full (1,200 repetition-specific records).
